question: In May 2025, Anurag Bhushan has been appointed as India’s next Ambassador to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sweden**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Anurag Bhushan** has been appointed as India's next Ambassador to **Sweden** in **May 2025**. 
• Sweden, a country in **northern Europe**, is known for its progressive policies, innovation, and strong diplomatic ties with India. 
• India and Sweden share a **bilateral relationship** that focuses on areas such as **trade, technology, sustainable development, and innovation.** 
• The appointment of Anurag Bhushan reflects India's efforts to strengthen its **diplomatic presence** and enhance collaboration with Sweden in strategic sectors. 
• Sweden is an important partner for India in the areas of **renewable energy, climate change, and innovation ecosystems.** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Sweden**: 
• Sweden is located in **Northern Europe** and is a part of the Scandinavian Peninsula. 
• Its capital is **Stockholm**, and it is known for its high standard of living, innovation, and sustainable practices. 
• Sweden has a strong economy driven by **technology, automotive, and renewable energy sectors.** 
• **India-Sweden Relations**: 
• India and Sweden have a long-standing diplomatic relationship, with Sweden being one of the first countries to recognize India’s independence in **1947**. 
• Both countries collaborate in areas like **trade, technology, innovation, and climate action.** 
• Sweden is also a strong proponent of the **India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA).** 
• **Past Diplomatic Representation**: 
• India has maintained a strong diplomatic presence in Sweden, with ambassadors facilitating bilateral trade and cultural exchange. 
• Sweden has also been actively involved in promoting **green energy and innovation partnerships** with India. 
• **Relevant Facts About Sweden**: 
• Sweden ranks high on the **Human Development Index** and is known for its welfare policies. 
• It is a member of the **European Union** and plays an active role in global diplomatic and environmental initiatives. 
• Sweden is home to globally renowned companies like **IKEA, Volvo, and Ericsson.** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Bilateral Trade:** 
• India and Sweden have a robust trade relationship, with bilateral trade amounting to several billion USD annually. 
• Sweden is also a significant investor in India, especially in sectors like **manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and technology.** 
• **Technology and Innovation:** 
• Sweden is one of the most innovative countries globally and collaborates with India on **smart cities, digitalization, and green technology.** 
• The **India-Sweden Innovation Partnership** aims to address global challenges through joint initiatives. 
• **Climate Action:** 
• Both countries are committed to the **Paris Agreement** and work together on **renewable energy projects and carbon reduction strategies.** 
• Sweden has supported India’s **International Solar Alliance (ISA)** initiative.
